text:
jae: Auditor asked for an RBAC + KMS proof package for ticket SEC-712. Wants chain of custody from report -> ticket -> PR -> deploy -> audit logs. Sampling is OK.
sam: I can collect the k8s audit slice and the deployment pipeline run. Any redaction rules?
auditor_mike: Redact PII and hostnames. Provide a documented transformation (algorithm + salt) and an attestation that originals are retained securely. One control-per-PDF for SOC2/ISO mapping.
lena: For KMS, we need Encrypt/Decrypt and key-rotation entries. Logs in bq: prod.kms_events. I'll export CSV and pseudonymize principal_emails.
jae: PR for RBAC change is https://github.com/redwood/security/pull/4096 (branch: hotfix/sec-712-rbac). Deploy tag: v2026.4.1 deployed 2026-04-09T14:22Z.
sam: Quick extraction I ran:
```
kubectl logs -n kube-system audit-collector --since=48h | jq 'select(.objectRef.kind=="Deployment" and .objectRef.name=="auth-service")' > /tmp/auth-audit.json
```
Got ~3.1k events; will run redaction pass.
lena: BigQuery example for KMS slice I used:
```
SELECT timestamp, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.methodName, resourceName
FROM `prod.kms_events`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName IN ("Encrypt", "Decrypt", "Rotate")
  AND timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP("2026-04-01") AND TIMESTAMP("2026-04-10")
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 2000;
```
I plan to pseudonymize emails with sha256(email + salt).
jae: Security: acceptable approach? store mapping in internal vault?
sec-eng: Yes. Keep original->hash mapping in internal-keystore. Do not include mapping in exported bundle. Document mapping method (sha256) and salt handling in manifest.
auditor_mike: Masked IPs/hostnames are fine if you include a signed attestation that originals are available on request under NDA. Also preserve log context lines (1-2) around each event.
sam: Redaction snippet (sed):
```
sed -E 's/"principalEmail":\s*"[^"]+"/"principalEmail":"REDACTED"/g' auth-audit.json > auth-audit-redacted.json
```
I'll keep a local index mapping hashed->original in the vault.
lena: For KMS pseudonymization (python):
```
import hashlib
SALT = b"prod-evidence-2026"
def pseudonymize(v): return hashlib.sha256(v.encode()+SALT).hexdigest()
```
Include method and SALT storage notes in README.
jae: Packaging plan: manifest.json, control-crosswalk.pdf (SOC2 CC6/CC7, ISO A.9/A.12), pr-and-ci.pdf (screenshots allowed), logs-redacted.tar.gz, kms-csv-redacted.csv, attestation-signed.pdf. Host to gs://redwood-evidence/sec-712/.
ops-bot: evidence-pack job started: sec-712-evidence-1777004444.zip (building 5 artifacts). ETA ~90s.
jae: One ask from security: include KMS key metadata showing HSM-backed and rotation schedule (screenshot OK).
sec-eng: Added note and signed KMS statement. Also include key version IDs used during the deploy window.
auditor_mike: Good. I may request a single unredacted log line for validation under NDA. Please include escalation path in README.
sam: Upload complete: gs://redwood-evidence/sec-712/sec-712-evidence-1777004444.zip (3.8MB). sha256: 3b7f1a9d... (manifest contains full hash).
jae: PR to compliance mapping: https://github.com/redwood/compliance/pull/128 — contains mapping table filename -> SOC2/ISO control.
lena: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with evidence ticket SEC-712-EVID in JIRA.
auditor_mike: I'll review and ACK or request NDA sample. Thanks everyone.
jae: Closing thread once auditor ACKs.
